scope.baseline: Link 59 plus the CPU-to-Chip C2J-seal WPLTO First Red
scope.purpose: test one named capped second Session payload region in Bank 5 before any format or product implementation

geometry.self_defense: overflow of this region or encroachment below the growth floor triggers scope triage; a third Session region is forbidden

format_question.required_property: every catalog record names its payload region and its u16 offset is relative to that region
format_question.asymmetry: one strict decoder; no dual decoder

gates: unknown or third region fails closed
per-region offsets are aligned and range-checked
both regions share one dense slot/catalog truth
packing accounts for both regions and rejects missing or surplus payloads
every region-1 load uses the canonical Bank-5 Chip-DMA seam
Bank-5 overflow does not overlap C2D, emitter roots, C2J or the external symbol arena
